Aatrox.name: Aatrox
Aatrox.winRateSource: lolalytics Jax top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 1,821 games
Aatrox.summary: Aatrox bullies you early with Q sweet spots, but once he misses Qs or you hit Trinity Force you win extended fights. Dodge the Q edges, trade on his Q cooldown, and win later.
Aatrox.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind/Conditioning, Overgrowth) for a safe lane; Lethal Tempo if you are confident in your trades
Aatrox.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion (Doran's Helm is also an option)
Aatrox.buildNotes: Trinity Force > Plated Steelcaps > Sundered Sky. Buy Executioner's Calling early if he is snowballing on healing, and turn it into Chempunk Chainsword. Sterak's Gage and Death's Dance are good follow-ups.
Aatrox.skillNotes: Start E. Take Q at 2 so you can jump into or out of his Q sweet spots. Max W, then E.

lvl1_3: Don't stand at the edge of his Q. Walk into him or Q onto him (or Q away to a minion) so the Q hits you on the weak inner part.
Trade right after he uses Q3. His Q is his whole lane, so you are free for several seconds.
Counter Strike takes 25% less damage from his AoE Q hits. Pop it as you commit, not before.
lvl4_5: When Infernal Chains (W) lands, walk toward the center or Q a minion inside the chain so you don't get pulled.
Play for short Q > auto > W > E trades while his Q is down, then back off before he gets it again.
post6: World Ender gives him big healing and move speed. Don't take extended fights into his R without anti-heal. Back off and fight again when it ends.
Once you have Trinity Force, you can take long fights when his Q is down and he has no R.
midgame: Split push. He has trouble catching you once your Grandmaster's Might is up and you have Sundered Sky.
In teamfights, keep Counter Strike for when he dives your backline with R.
lategame: You outduel him late when anti-heal is up. Take side-lane 1v1s after his R is used.

threats: Q3 sweet spot knockup: walk in or Q out of the edge.
Infernal Chains (W): leave the chain area early or Q to a unit in the middle.
World Ender (R) healing: buy anti-heal and wait out the duration.
Umbral Dash lets him reposition his Q, so don't assume a Q will miss.
killWindows: Right after a missed Q3, when he has no Q for several seconds.
When his R is down and you have R active plus a stacked passive.
avoid: Standing at max Q range, where the sweet spots land.
Fighting inside his R with no anti-heal.
Using Counter Strike before he commits Q.

Ambessa.name: Ambessa
Ambessa.winRateSource: lolalytics Jax top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 1,051 games
Ambessa.summary: Ambessa is slightly favored. Her dashes let her dodge your Counter Strike stun, and her Repudiation (W) punishes you for dumping damage into it. Wait for her to use her dashes and W, then all-in.
Ambessa.runes: Grasp of the Undying for a safer lane, or Press the Attack (most played in this matchup on lolalytics)
Ambessa.summoners: Flash + Ignite (most played); Flash + Teleport if you want to play safe
Ambessa.start: Doran's Blade or Doran's Bow + Health Potion
Ambessa.buildNotes: Trinity Force > Plated Steelcaps > Sundered Sky. Death's Dance and Sterak's Gage are strong against her burst trades.
Ambessa.skillNotes: Start E. Standard order: Q at 2, W at 3, then max W.

lvl1_3: Counter Strike blocks her Drakehound's Step empowered autos. Start E when she dashes in.
Don't auto into Repudiation (W) while she is braced. Blocked damage makes the slam hit harder. Step back and re-engage after it ends.
lvl4_5: Count her dashes. After Cunning Sweep/Sundering Slam and Lacerate are down she has no way to leave your Counter Strike stun, so Q in then.
Keep trades short while she has energy and all her abilities up.
post6: Public Execution (R) blinks to you and suppresses. Save Flash or Q for after it, and turn on Grandmaster's Might to survive the combo.
All-in once she has used R. Your sustained damage beats her after her burst is spent.
midgame: Split push, but respect her R pick potential when you are overextended.
In teamfights, go in after she commits R onto someone.
lategame: You scale well. Duel her once her dashes are gone and don't chase her through walls.

threats: Repudiation (W) shield and slam: stop hitting her while she is braced.
Lots of dashes that dodge your Counter Strike stun: pop E after she has used them.
Public Execution (R) suppression: hold defensive tools for it.
killWindows: After she has used her dashes and W in a trade.
Post-6, right after her R is used.
avoid: Auto attacking into her braced W.
Recasting Counter Strike early while she still has dashes.

Camille.name: Camille
Camille.winRateSource: lolalytics Jax top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 1,625 games
Camille.summary: You are favored. Her Precision Protocol (Q) damage comes from basic attacks, which Counter Strike blocks. Block the true-damage Q2, stun her as she lands Hookshot, and win trades.
Camille.runes: Press the Attack (strong in this matchup on lolalytics) or Lethal Tempo
Camille.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion or Doran's Blade + Health Potion
Camille.buildNotes: Trinity Force > Plated Steelcaps > Sundered Sky. Add Death's Dance if she builds lethality or burst.
Camille.skillNotes: Start E. Q at 2, W at 3, max W.

lvl1_3: When her Q is charged for the true-damage second hit, use Counter Strike so she wastes it.
Hookshot (E): recast Counter Strike to stun her as she dashes or lands on you. Stunning her mid-pull cancels the dash.
lvl4_5: Dodge the outer edge of Tactical Sweep (W) so she doesn't get the slow and heal.
Once she has used E, she can't escape. Q onto her and finish the trade.
post6: You can't dash out of The Hextech Ultimatum (R). When she ults, turn on Counter Strike and Grandmaster's Might and fight her inside it.
You win the all-in when your Counter Strike lines up with her Q2.
midgame: Split push. You beat her 1v1 with even items.
Watch out for her flanks in teamfights and keep Counter Strike ready for her Hookshot engage.
lategame: You still win side-lane duels. Keep your stun for her E engage.

threats: Precision Protocol second hit (true damage): block it with Counter Strike.
Hookshot stun: time your E recast to cancel or answer it.
Hextech Ultimatum (R) traps you, so you can't Q away.
killWindows: After she used E to engage and you blocked her Q2.
Any time her E is on cooldown.
avoid: Using Counter Strike before her Q is charged.
Standing on the outer edge of her W.

Darius.name: Darius
Darius.winRateSource: lolalytics Jax top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 2,079 games
Darius.summary: Darius wins long early fights once he has bleed stacks, but you win later with Trinity Force and a good split push. Dodge the Decimate (Q) blade, trade when Q is down, and never fight into 5 stacks.
Darius.runes: Grasp of the Undying (most played and best-performing keystone here on lolalytics)
Darius.summoners: Flash + Teleport, or Flash + Exhaust for his all-ins
Darius.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion (safe) or Doran's Bow + 2 Health Potion (most played on lolalytics)
Darius.buildNotes: Trinity Force > Plated Steelcaps > Sterak's Gage or Sundered Sky. Death's Dance helps against the bleed. Buy Executioner's Calling if his Q healing wins trades.
Darius.skillNotes: Start E. Q at 2 so you can dodge Decimate by jumping in or away. Max W.

lvl1_3: Walk into him, or Q onto him, when he winds up Decimate (Q) so the heal-applying blade misses you.
Use Counter Strike to block Crippling Strike (W) and his bleed autos. His Q is an ability and E doesn't block it, so keep moving.
Last hit with Q from range if he is zoning you. Don't let him auto you up to bleed stacks for free.
lvl4_5: Trade only while his Q is on cooldown: Q > auto > W > E, then leave.
Apprehend (E) can pull you back as you Q away. Use Q to escape after his E, not before.
post6: Don't fight at 3 or more bleed stacks. Noxian Guillotine (R) does true damage and resets when he gets a kill.
Once his Q is down, all-in with R active and hold Counter Strike for his autos.
midgame: Split push. Trinity Force + Plated Steelcaps is when you start beating him in side lane.
Don't group for fights where he can get 5 stacks on you.
lategame: You outscale him. Kite his Q with Leap Strike and fight in bursts.

threats: Decimate (Q) blade: heals him and stacks bleed. Dodge by moving into the handle area.
Crippling Strike (W) slow makes Q easy to land. Block it with Counter Strike.
Apprehend (E) pulls you back when you try to escape.
Noxian Guillotine (R) true damage execute, which resets.
killWindows: Right after he misses Decimate.
After his E is used and you have Counter Strike ready.
avoid: Extended trades with his bleed stacked.
Using Counter Strike too early so he waits it out.
Standing at blade range when his Q is up.

Fiora.name: Fiora
Fiora.winRateSource: lolalytics Jax top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 1,437 games
Fiora.summary: An even skill matchup that Fiora wins if she Ripostes your stun. If she parries Counter Strike, you get stunned and usually die. Bait out or wait out her Riposte (W) before your stun lands.
Fiora.runes: Grasp of the Undying (highest win rate keystone here on lolalytics)
Fiora.start: Doran's Bow + 2 Health Potion or Doran's Shield + Health Potion
Fiora.buildNotes: Trinity Force > Plated Steelcaps > Sundered Sky. Death's Dance and Sterak's Gage help you survive her vital procs.
Fiora.skillNotes: Start E. Max W, then Q.

lvl1_3: Keep Counter Strike up for the full duration instead of recasting early. Most Fioras try to Riposte the stun early.
Counter Strike blocks her autos and Bladework (E) attacks. Lunge (Q) is an ability and still hits you.
lvl4_5: Use Riposte's cooldown: once she wastes W on a minion wave or your autos, recast E right away and all-in.
Don't let her proc vitals for free. Step back when a vital faces you.
post6: Grand Challenge (R) heals her a lot if she procs all four vitals. Kill her quickly or leave.
Your E stun is only safe when her W is on cooldown.
midgame: Avoid long even 1v1s. She outscales many bruisers in side lane.
In teamfights, go in after she commits R.
lategame: Respect her 1v1. Fight with vision and your team nearby.

threats: Riposte (W): parries your Counter Strike stun and stuns you back.
killWindows: After she wasted Riposte on something else.
When her Q is on cooldown and she can't reposition.
avoid: Recasting Counter Strike early.
Standing still next to her vitals.
Extended fights when she has R and W up.

Garen.name: Garen
Garen.winRateSource: lolalytics Jax top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 2,814 games
Garen.summary: A slightly losing lane. Garen's Decisive Strike (Q) silence and his passive sustain are annoying. Block his Q with Counter Strike, respect Judgment (E), and play for scaling.
Garen.runes: Press the Attack (most played) or Grasp of the Undying
Garen.start: Doran's Bow + 2 Health Potion or Doran's Shield + Health Potion
Garen.buildNotes: Trinity Force > Plated Steelcaps > Sundered Sky. Blade of the Ruined King is solid against his health stacking. Death's Dance and Sterak's Gage help late.

lvl1_3: Decisive Strike (Q) empowers his next basic attack, so Counter Strike dodges it and the silence.
Judgment (E) spin is AoE ability damage. Counter Strike only cuts it by 25%, so leave the spin instead of face-tanking it.
lvl4_5: Short trades don't work well because his passive heals him back. Look for all-ins with Ignite or Exhaust.
Courage (W) reduces damage. Wait it out before your big trade.
post6: Demacian Justice (R) executes based on your missing health. Don't stay at low HP in his range.
Your all-in with R active beats him if you blocked his Q.
midgame: Split push. He can hold side lane, so push with TP or your jungler's help.
In teamfights, keep Counter Strike for his Q engage.
lategame: You outscale him in DPS. Fight with Counter Strike ready.

threats: Decisive Strike (Q) silence: dodge with Counter Strike.
killWindows: After he used Q into your Counter Strike.
When his W is on cooldown.
avoid: Getting silenced without E up.
Fighting in his spin.
Staying low near his R range.

Gwen.name: Gwen
Gwen.winRateSource: lolalytics Jax top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 764 games
Gwen.summary: You are favored. Gwen's autos and Skip 'n Slash (E) attacks are blocked by Counter Strike. Walk into her Hallowed Mist (W) instead of trying to target her from outside it.
Gwen.runes: Grasp of the Undying (most played) or Press the Attack
Gwen.start: Doran's Bow + 2 Health Potion, or Doran's Helm into magic damage
Gwen.buildNotes: Trinity Force > Mercury's Treads > Wit's End. Hybrid Dusk and Dawn builds are also common against her. Kaenic Rookern is an option later.

lvl1_3: When she dashes with E for attack speed, use Counter Strike to block her autos.
Stay out of the center of Snip Snip! (Q). That's where the true damage hits.
lvl4_5: Hallowed Mist (W) makes her untargetable from outside. Walk into the mist to hit her.
Once she uses E, all-in with Q > W > Counter Strike.
post6: Needlework (R) slows you. Use Grandmaster's Might for MR and stick to her.
Her kit loses a lot when Counter Strike blocks her autos.
midgame: Split push. Wit's End makes you win side-lane duels.
In teamfights, walk into her mist or pick other targets.
lategame: Respect her true damage late. Keep Counter Strike ready for her engage.

killWindows: After she uses Skip 'n Slash (E).
When her Hallowed Mist is on cooldown.
avoid: Trying to target her from outside the mist.
Standing in the center of her Q.

Illaoi.name: Illaoi
Illaoi.winRateSource: lolalytics Jax top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 739 games
Illaoi.summary: Illaoi is favored when you fight near her tentacles. Dodge Test of Spirit (E) with minion cover, fight away from tentacles, and never all-in during Leap of Faith (R).
Illaoi.runes: Press the Attack (most played) or Grasp of the Undying
Illaoi.buildNotes: Trinity Force > Plated Steelcaps > Sundered Sky. Buy Executioner's Calling (into Chempunk Chainsword) against her heals. Blade of the Ruined King is also an option.

lvl1_3: Stand behind minions so Test of Spirit (E) is blocked.
Counter Strike cuts tentacle slam damage by 25%, but move away from tentacles anyway.
lvl4_5: If she pulls your spirit, Q to a minion or ward outside the tether range or stay behind the vessel.
Trade when her E is on cooldown and no tentacles are near.
post6: Leap of Faith (R) spawns tentacles and heals her a lot. Q out or wait until it ends.
All-in after her R is used and her E has missed.
midgame: Split push away from her. She holds side lanes well.
In teamfights, go in after she commits R.
lategame: You outscale in DPS, but don't fight on her tentacles.

threats: Test of Spirit (E): pulls your spirit and makes you vulnerable.
Leap of Faith (R) tentacle burst and heal.
killWindows: After her E misses.
Once her R is on cooldown and no tentacles are up.
avoid: Fighting on her tentacles.
Standing in line for Test of Spirit.
All-ins during her R.

Irelia.name: Irelia
Irelia.winRateSource: lolalytics Jax top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 1,546 games
Irelia.summary: You are favored. Irelia's damage comes from stacked autos, and Counter Strike blocks them. Dodge Flawless Duet (E) and stun her after she dashes in.
Irelia.runes: Press the Attack (most played and best-performing here on lolalytics)
Irelia.buildNotes: Trinity Force or Blade of the Ruined King > Plated Steelcaps > Death's Dance. Sundered Sky is also good.
Irelia.skillNotes: Start E. Max W, then E.

lvl1_3: When she dashes in with stacks, pop Counter Strike and recast to stun her.
She stacks Ionian Fervor on minions. Punish her when she stacks up on the wave.
lvl4_5: Dodge Flawless Duet (E) by moving sideways or Q to a minion.
Defiant Dance (W) reduces damage. Wait it out before you all-in.
post6: Vanguard's Edge (R) makes a wall of blades that slows you. Use Grandmaster's Might for resists and fight her inside it.
Your E stun lands if she can't dash out.
midgame: Split push. You outduel her with even items.
In teamfights, save Counter Strike for her Q-resets.
lategame: You outscale her. Block her autos and win.

killWindows: After her E misses.
When her stacks are low.
avoid: Getting hit by E stun.
Using Counter Strike before she commits.

Jax.name: Jax
Jax.summary: A pure Counter Strike (E) timing mirror. Whoever wastes E first loses the trade. Never auto into their active E, and press yours after theirs so you can walk out of their stun and land yours.
Jax.runes: Standard (Grasp of the Undying or Lethal Tempo). Mirror whatever keeps you even and play for the item spike.
Jax.summoners: Flash + Ignite for a kill-lane mirror; Flash + Teleport to play safe
Jax.start: Doran's Blade + Health Potion (Doran's Bow + 2 Health Potion is also common)
Jax.buildNotes: Standard: Trinity Force > Plated Steelcaps > Sundered Sky. Plated Steelcaps are strong because most of his damage comes from autos. Death's Dance is good third or fourth.
Jax.skillNotes: Start E. Q at 2 so you can reposition around his E. Max W.

lvl1_3: When he pops Counter Strike, stop auto attacking and walk out of the stun radius. Don't feed damage into his E.
Pop your own E only after he has committed his. You block his autos while his stun whiffs, and your stun lands when he walks back in.
lvl4_5: Trade on his Counter Strike cooldown: Q > auto > W > auto, then leave.
If he Leap Strikes onto you with E up, Q away to a minion or ward. Don't stand inside his stun.
post6: Grandmaster's Might (R) active gives both of you resists. Fight when his R is on cooldown and yours is up.
Relentless Assault stacks decide long fights. Don't take an all-in when he already has passive stacks from farming.
midgame: Split push hard. The first Jax to finish Trinity Force + Sundered Sky wins the side lane.
In teamfights, bait his E onto someone else before you engage.
lategame: Same as midgame. The item and level lead decides it. Hold Counter Strike until he commits his.

threats: His Counter Strike stun and the damage it stores.
Grandmaster's Might active resists in all-ins.
His Leap Strike engage when your E is on cooldown.
killWindows: When his E is on cooldown and yours is up.
After his R active has ended.
avoid: Auto attacking into his active E.
Using your E first in an even trade.

Kled.name: Kled
Kled.winRateSource: lolalytics Jax top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 642 games
Kled.summary: An even lane where Kled wins levels 1-3 all-ins. Counter Strike blocks his Violent Tendencies (W) autos. Break the Beartrap on a Rope tether, survive early, and punish him hard when Skaarl dismounts.
Kled.runes: Press the Attack (most played) or Grasp of the Undying for a safer lane
Kled.buildNotes: Trinity Force > Plated Steelcaps > Sundered Sky. Death's Dance and Sterak's Gage help against his burst all-ins.

lvl1_3: Violent Tendencies (W) gives him 4 fast autos. Pop Counter Strike as soon as the attack speed starts and stun him at the end.
If Beartrap on a Rope (Q) hits you, walk away from him to break the tether before it yanks. Don't walk toward him.
lvl4_5: When Skaarl dismounts, dismounted Kled is weak and slow. Q in and all-in before he remounts.
Jousting (E) second cast follows the target. Dodge the first dash sideways and punish him after.
post6: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (R) engages from far away and brings his team. Ward the side lanes and keep Counter Strike for when he arrives.
All-in with R active whenever he is dismounted.
midgame: Split push, but respect his R flank angles.
In teamfights, go in after he commits R. He has little left once he's dismounted.
lategame: You outscale him in dueling. Kill Skaarl, then kill Kled.

killWindows: When he is dismounted.
After his W has been blocked by your Counter Strike.
avoid: Staying tethered to his Q.
Taking an early all-in with your E on cooldown.

Mordekaiser.name: Mordekaiser
Mordekaiser.winRateSource: lolalytics Jax top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 1,410 games
Mordekaiser.summary: You are favored. Mordekaiser has no dashes, so you can Leap Strike out of Obliterate (Q), stun him easily, and outduel him in Realm of Death (R) once you have magic resist.
Mordekaiser.runes: Press the Attack (most played here on lolalytics) or Grasp of the Undying
Mordekaiser.summoners: Flash + Exhaust (Exhaust is very strong inside his R)
Mordekaiser.start: Doran's Bow + 2 Health Potion, or Doran's Helm to play safe
Mordekaiser.buildNotes: Trinity Force or the hybrid Dusk and Dawn > Mercury's Treads > Wit's End. Death's Dance is a good follow-up. Blade of the Ruined King is fine against his health.

lvl1_3: Obliterate (Q) does bonus damage when you are isolated. Stand near minions, and Q out to a minion or ward when he winds up.
Counter Strike cuts his AoE ability damage by 25% and stuns him. He has no dash to escape it.
lvl4_5: Death's Grasp (E) pull is slow. Sidestep it or Q away as it lands.
Trade when his Q is on cooldown. Hit his W shield last so he can't heal from it.
post6: Realm of Death (R) traps you in a 1v1 and steals your stats. Pop Grandmaster's Might for MR and time Counter Strike to stun him while he is inside.
Exhaust inside his realm usually wins you the duel.
midgame: Split push. Wit's End + Mercury's Treads make you win side-lane duels.
Watch out for his R on your carries. Your team can't help them inside it.
lategame: You outscale him. Hold Exhaust and Counter Strike for his R.

killWindows: After his Q misses.
When his W is on cooldown.
Inside his R once you have Exhaust and MR.
avoid: Getting pulled into his Q with E.
Fighting him while isolated at low HP.

Nasus.name: Nasus
Nasus.winRateSource: lolalytics Jax top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 1,293 games
Nasus.summary: You win lane. Bully him at levels 1-5, deny Siphoning Strike stacks, and snowball before he scales. Counter Strike blocks his Q.
Nasus.runes: Press the Attack or Lethal Tempo (aggressive), with Ignite
Nasus.buildNotes: Trinity Force > Plated Steelcaps > Blade of the Ruined King (good against his health stacking). Sundered Sky or Sterak's Gage after.
Nasus.skillNotes: Start E. Q at 2 for early trades. Max W.

lvl1_3: Trade aggressively. He has little damage early. Hit him whenever he walks up to last hit with Siphoning Strike (Q).
Siphoning Strike empowers his next basic attack, so Counter Strike dodges it.
lvl4_5: Look for a level 3-5 all-in with Ignite. His Spirit Fire (E) armor shred is his only real trade tool.
Freeze near your tower or crash waves so he loses stacks.
post6: Wither (W) slows you a lot and cuts your attack speed. Q to a minion or ward to get out, or fight when W is down.
Fury of the Sands (R) makes him tanky. Back off for its duration unless you already have the kill.
midgame: Split push and keep denying stacks. Force him to answer side lanes.
Roam or invade if he farms passively under tower.
lategame: He scales hard if the game drags. Use your lead to end, or buy Blade of the Ruined King and fight when his W is down.

threats: Fury of the Sands (R) late-game tankiness.
killWindows: Levels 2-5 with Ignite.
When his W is on cooldown.
avoid: Letting him farm stacks freely.
Fighting inside his R with no lead.

Olaf.name: Olaf
Olaf.winRateSource: lolalytics Jax top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 1,162 games
Olaf.summary: Even. Olaf wins levels 1-3 with Undertow (Q) and Reckless Swing (E) true damage, and Ragnarok (R) makes him immune to your stun. Dodge his axes, trade when he can't pick them up, and avoid fighting during his R.
Olaf.buildNotes: Trinity Force > Plated Steelcaps > Sundered Sky. Buy Executioner's Calling (into Chempunk Chainsword) if his Tough It Out (W) healing wins fights.

lvl1_3: Dodge Undertow (Q) axes. When he misses one, he has to walk to it, so step between him and the axe.
Counter Strike blocks his autos. Reckless Swing (E) is true damage from an ability, so it still hits you.
lvl4_5: Trade when his axe is on cooldown or on the ground far from him.
His W heals more at low HP. Don't give him a long fight where he heals up.
post6: During Ragnarok (R) he is immune to your stun. Walk away or Q to a minion and fight after it ends.
All-in when his R is on cooldown so your Counter Strike stun lands.
midgame: Split push. He falls off, but respect his R dives.
In teamfights, don't try to stun him during R. Peel or fight elsewhere.
lategame: You outscale him. Save Counter Strike until his R has ended.

killWindows: After his R ends.
When his axe is on the ground far from him.
avoid: Fighting during his R.
Long early trades where his W heals him.

Renekton.name: Renekton
Renekton.winRateSource: lolalytics Jax top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 1,558 games
Renekton.summary: Renekton wins early and falls off. Ruthless Predator (W) empowers his next basic attack, so Counter Strike dodges it. Respect his level 3 all-in, then scale.
Renekton.buildNotes: Trinity Force > Plated Steelcaps > Sundered Sky. Death's Dance is good against his burst.

lvl1_3: Pop Counter Strike when he dashes in with Slice and Dice (E) to dodge his W stun.
Respect his level 3 all-in (E > W > Q). Keep your E ready for it.
lvl4_5: Watch his fury. At 50+ fury his W stuns longer and his Q heals more. Back off when he is full.
Trade after he uses E. Without it he can't reach you.
post6: Dominus (R) gives him health and fury. Kite it out or hold Counter Strike for his W.
All-in when his fury is low and his E is on cooldown.
midgame: Split push. He falls off hard, so force side-lane duels.
In teamfights, keep Counter Strike for his E > W engage.
lategame: You outscale him. Fight on his cooldowns.

killWindows: When his fury is low.
After he uses E and your Counter Strike is ready.
avoid: Fighting when he has 50+ fury.
Using Counter Strike before he commits his E.

Riven.name: Riven
Riven.winRateSource: lolalytics Jax top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 635 games
Riven.summary: A skill matchup where you are slightly favored. Counter Strike blocks her Runic Blade autos and cuts her AoE Q/W damage by 25%. Wait for her to use her dashes, then stun and outtrade.
Riven.runes: Grasp of the Undying for a safe lane, or Lethal Tempo
Riven.buildNotes: Trinity Force > Plated Steelcaps > Death's Dance (good against her burst). Sterak's Gage is also good.

lvl1_3: Counter Strike blocks her Runic Blade autos, which are most of her damage.
Don't recast E while her Valor (E) shield is up. Wait until her dashes are used.
lvl4_5: Dodge Ki Burst (W) stun by staying out of her short range or Q-ing away.
Trade after she uses Q3. She has no gap-closer left.
post6: Blade of the Exile (R) gives her AD and Wind Slash, an execute. Don't fight at low HP.
All-in when her E and Q3 are on cooldown.
midgame: Split push. You win side-lane duels with even items.
